integrity: The statement is proved using martingale covariance recursions and a Beta-Hankel Gram determinant; exact-rational finite-model tests are corroborative only. Historical priority is assessed against inspected sources, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Fixed number of types, fixed reproduction and immigration laws; finite second moments, positive adjacent transfer rates, positive type-one immigration mean and offspring variance. No simultaneous growing-type population theorem. Historical coverage of Foster-Ney (1978) remains incompletely inspected.
title: Universal cross-type correlations in critical decomposable branching with immigration
